description: Send a follow-up message to a previous delegation using its thread_id. Codex retains the earlier context, so only the new instruction needs to be sent. Like a delegation, it is sent to OpenAI and spends the user's Codex usage.

auto_approve.description: Not supported on follow-ups: true is refused and nothing runs.

label.description: Your own short name for this kind of task, stored verbatim in the local usage log and never sent to Codex: 1 to 64 characters, no control or bidirectional-control characters. A follow-up without one keeps its thread's label.

model.description: Override the model for this turn. Defaults to the thread's last model from memory or, on a registry miss, Codex's session file; if neither has it, the configured default, else the call is refused.

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema object for this turn's final message, which then comes back as JSON in a delimited block. OpenAI's structured outputs apply: every object needs "additionalProperties": false and every property listed in "required". At most 64 KiB serialised.

reasoning_effort.description: Override the reasoning effort for this turn. Defaults to the thread's last effort when the model is unchanged, otherwise to the configured or model default.

sandbox.description: Sandbox policy for this turn. Uses the configured default when omitted; read-only when unset.

thread_id.description: The thread_id reported by a previous codex_delegate call.

working_dir.description: Absolute directory to resume in. Defaults to the directory the thread last ran in.

name: codex_follow_up
title: Continue a Codex session
